title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 - ELBASANI STREET NEAR THE LAKE PARK.
description_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 - ELBASANI STREET NEAR THE LAKE PARK. We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in a multifunctional residential building in one of the most popular areas of Tirana, at the intersection of Elbasani Street and Tre Vellezerit Kondit Street. The construction will be completed in 2026 and includes residential apartments, hotel and service facilities, there is an organization and structure of 5,6,7 and 8 floors, with 3 floors of underground parking. The apartment is located on the 6th floor facing south-west - the view from the lake park in Tirana. Organization of the apartment: • Living room and kitchen, • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Veranda Details: Total Area 111.54 m2 Net Sip 80.34 m2 Common Sip 16.2 m2 Sip Veranda 15 m2 For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
